visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young boy stands centered on a small, red-rimmed elevated platform against a vibrant, story-themed backdrop. He wears a bright pink pig-shaped hat with ears and a face, a matching pink t-shirt featuring a small pig icon on the left chest, and pink shorts. Around his neck hangs a blue plush bag shaped like a police dog. He has black-rimmed glasses, white socks, and black dress shoes. He begins the performance with his hands raised high in the air, his mouth open in an active speaking pose, while his eyes are focused forward. The backdrop is a light blue sheet decorated with large cartoon animal cutouts: a brown bear on the left, a blue koala at the bottom left, and a lion on the right. (2) Moving into the main storytelling section, the boy transitions through a series of energetic gestures to accompany his spoken words. He points towards the sky, mimics rolling in mud by rotating his hands, and places his hands near his mouth to simulate eating. When portraying the 'angry cow', he places his hands on his hips and puffs out his chest slightly. His facial expressions shift frequently, showing excitement, boredom, and pride according to the narrative flow. He jumps slightly on the platform at certain points of emphasis. The camera remains entirely static, keeping the boy's full body in frame. (3) In the final segment, the boy brings the story to a close, standing with his hands neatly at his sides or gesturing slightly to emphasize the moral of the story. He maintains a confident posture, standing tall on the platform. After finishing his final sentence, he performs a polite bow, lowering his head and hands. He then looks back at the camera with a smile, showing his clear facial features through his glasses. The environment remains unchanged, with no other people entering the frame. The text overlays at the bottom of the screen reflect his closing remarks.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: Good morning everyone. (2) [Subtitle]: My name is Linus. (3) [Subtitle]: My story is The lazy little pig. (4) [Subtitle]: Once upon a time there was a little pig who lived on Happy farm. (5) [Subtitle]: He was the laziest animal on the farm. (6) [Subtitle]: Every animal on the farm had a job. (7) [Subtitle]: the old cow Plowed the field. (8) [Subtitle]: the little horse carried things. (9) [Subtitle]: and the hen laid eggs. (10) [Subtitle]: But the little pig never had to do anything. (11) [Subtitle]: Everyday, the little pig Only ate, slept, and rolled in the mud. (12) [Subtitle]: he looked very happy. (13) [Subtitle]: But the other animals were not happy. (14) [Subtitle]: they thought it was unfair. (15) [Subtitle]: why didn't the pig have to work. (16) [Subtitle]: and he always got the best food? (17) [Subtitle]: one day the old cow and the little horse went to talk to the pig. (18) [Subtitle]: Hey, Pig! This is not fair! (19) [Subtitle]: We work so hard every day just to get our food. (20) [Subtitle]: But you only sleep all day. (21) [Subtitle]: The pig said proudly, That's because the farmer likes me more. (22) [Subtitle]: After all, I'm a pig! (23) [Subtitle]: The old cow shouted angrily, This is not fair. (24) [Subtitle]: You don't work at all, you only eat. Aren't you ashamed? (25) [Subtitle]: The pig answered lazily, No, I just like being lazy. (26) [Subtitle]: Alright, it's my tea time now. I don't want to talk anymore. Bye-bye! (27) [Subtitle]: One night, the farmer said to his friend. (28) [Subtitle]: Our pig is fat enough now. (29) [Subtitle]: If we sell him at the market, we will make a lot of money. Hahahaha. (30) [Subtitle]: The little horse happened to pass by and heard the farmer's words. (31) [Subtitle]: He was so shocked, he ran back to the barn and told everyone. (32) [Subtitle]: Oh, I heard the farmer say he's going to sell Big Fat Pig! (33) [Subtitle]: All the animals finally understood. (34) [Subtitle]: So this is why the pig never had to work. (35) [Subtitle]: They sighed and said, There is no such thing as a free lunch. (36) [Subtitle]: We'd better keep working hard. (37) [Subtitle]: The animals decided not to tell Big Fat Pig the truth. (38) [Subtitle]: Even when the farmer put him on the truck, the pig was still fast asleep. (39) [Subtitle]: In his dream, he was flying on an airplane, eating delicious food, and getting ready to travel around the world. (40) [Subtitle]: This is my story. Thank you everyone.
